topic: Kanyakumari sunrise and sunset over sea
hook: Your sunrise and sunset can both happen over the sea at this spot.
title: India's Tip Where Both Sun Events Hit the Sea
description:
At Kanyakumari, the southern tip of India, the Bay of Bengal, the Arabian Sea and the Indian Ocean meet. On clear days you can watch the sun rise over the water and set over the water from the same shore. It is one of the most visited coasts in India.
